sloka: भगीरथात् ककुत्स्थस्तु काकुत्स्था येन विश्रुता: ।ककुत्स्थस्य च पुत्रो ऽभूद्रघुर्येन तु राघवा: ॥ २.११०.२५॥
transliteration: bhagīrathāt kakutsthastu kākutsthā yena viśrutā: ।kakutsthasya ca putro 'bhūdraghuryena tu rāghavā: ॥ 2.110.25॥

translations.english: We have heard that a son, Asamanja by name, was born to Sagara. For his sinful deeds he was banished by his father while he was still alive.
